text: {"name":"ctrl_request_submit","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Submits a control request by storing it as pending when a request is already queued, or otherwise updating the active request and sending the associated kernel notification.","subsystem":"wlan","var_renames":{"v2":"new_request","v3":"active_request","v4":"request_notice_payload","v8":"request_event_msg"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":16,"meaning":"Request lifecycle state; set to 2 on activation and 4 when the active request is submitted again."},{"offset":24,"meaning":"Request byte copied into a notice message when the request is displaced; value 3 suppresses that notice."},{"offset":40,"meaning":"Active request pointer in the control context."},{"offset":44,"meaning":"Pending request pointer in the control context."}]}
